teacher_info.about_teacher:
Teaching people and helping them improve is my call in life. Learning must be done in collaboration among teachers and students, so if I don't know the answer to something, I'll do research on it so that everyone learns something new at the end of the day.

I believe that constant correction (while talking) is helpful to improve as long as it happens in a safe environment. So, if my students don't want to be corrected in that manner, it'll be okay. I'm here to provide a safe haven for learning.

Whatever your goal is, I'll accompany you and explore the language and its aspect as deeply as you are willing to go.

You make the rules. I bend them so that you can learn.
teacher_info.teaching_style:

En mis clases, la conversación fluida es clave.

Trabajaré para satisfacer todas las necesidades del estudiante.
